intro: Beyond the edge of every screen, past the last level of every game and somewhere just behind your dreams, floats the Mazeverse: an enormous, glowing maze that rebuilds itself every night. Its paths connect everything — hallways, rivers, treetops and stars. And keeping those paths open is the job of five friends called the Maze Guardians.

map.alt: Map of the Mazeverse: the Compass Core sits in the middle, surrounded by four zones — Frost Fields, Rustbolt Junkyard, Splash Sea and Neon City

places.name: The Compass Core
places.text: A giant spinning compass at the centre of the Mazeverse. As long as it spins, every path has a way out. If it wobbles, the maze gets scrambled — and everyone gets lost.

places.name: Lighthouse HQ
places.text: The Guardians' headquarters. Its beam sweeps the maze every night so nobody is ever left in the dark. The kitchen is mostly a pancake factory.

places.name: Neon City
places.text: Glowing towers, hover-scooters and the best snack stands in the Mazeverse. Grumblejaw keeps stomping through it on his way to nowhere in particular.

places.name: Frost Fields
places.text: Snowy, sparkly and full of icy puddles. Home of Blizzardbyte the Glitch Yeti, who has never once been invited to a snowball fight.

places.name: Splash Sea & the Grape-Jelly Dunes
places.text: A bright blue sea that crashes onto purple dunes that wobble when you walk on them. Splashfang the Wave Serpent lives in the deepest, splashiest part.

places.name: Rustbolt Junkyard
places.text: Mountains of old bolts, springs and broken toasters. Grumblejaw built himself here, and he is still looking for a missing bolt.

code.title: The Guardian Code
rules: Share the map — and the snacks.
Be kind to Glitchlings. They are mostly just confused.
If you get stuck, ask a friend. Two heads are better than one. Three heads (ask Dragoncrest) are complicated.
